_comment: Round 6 additions that are NOT harvest-derived. Both are navigation labels of the main bottom bar: the harvest never logged them, so they were identified from the game's own string literals in muv_luv_girlsgardenx_cl_Data\il2cpp_data\Metadata\global-metadata.dat (a 'サークル' literal sits next to the other tab labels; 'サンルーム' does not exist in the game at all). They are exact-match strings with no digit runs.
_evidence: MuvluvMod.cfg CdnURL=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dorimerrr/RamiLabu/refs/heads/main, and the client renders tab labels through TMP_Text, which the UI resolver covers.
